title: code_changes.json
description: Schema for .ai/blueteam/data/code_changes.json — code-level fixes required to remediate security findings

generated_by_assessments.description: List of assessment report names (without .md extension) that contributed entries

changes.description: Code-level fixes derived from assessment findings

id.description: Sequential identifier: CC-001, CC-002, etc. Never reused or renumbered.

title.description: Imperative verb phrase describing the change, max 80 chars

priority.description: Priority derived from the highest severity source finding

line_reference.description: Line number (e.g. 118), range (e.g. 162-177), or null for whole-file changes

description.description: What must change, why it matters, and the consequence of not fixing — 2-3 sentences

current_code_summary.description: Single sentence describing the vulnerable construct; null for pure additions

replacement_code.description: The exact replacement code; null when extracted from threat model

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria verifying the change is complete and correct

sources.description: References to source findings in assessment reports

cas_rules.description: CAS rule IDs this change addresses; empty array if none

asvs_requirements.description: ASVS requirement IDs (e.g. V2.2.1); empty array if none

related_requirement_ids.description: SR-NNN IDs from security_requirements.json; populated during merge

callsite_impact.description: Present when this change modifies a function or method signature

scope_check.description: Present when the fix may need to be applied at additional code paths
